thread:
mike: Heads up, I bumped @redwood/sdk to 0.8.0 in examples/onboarding and CI churned. Node 14 + Jest can't require the package anymore.

olivia: Can you paste the error from CI?

mike: Sure: ```TypeError: require(...).default is undefined
 at Object.<anonymous> (examples/onboarding/test/setup.js:2:22)```

rachel: This smells like we removed the CJS surface when updating package.json exports. Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers) resolve the exports map differently so imports that worked in Node ESM break in Worker MJS.

ben: Repro locally: worker emulation fails with: ```Error: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'```

mike: The onboarding sample still uses `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` in a few spots. Our types also include `export default` in index.d.ts which makes TS users think default exists.

olivia: Quick mitigations: (1) update examples to use `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` or `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'`, (2) add a CJS compat entry in the package and reintroduce a default wrapper.

rachel: I'll open a patch PR to add an `exports."."` CJS fallback and ship a small `cjs/index.js` that sets `module.exports = require('../dist/esm').default || require('../dist/esm')`. Also will add a `types` re-export that keeps `export default` for consumers to avoid TS errors.

ben: Heads-up: auth/retry middleware in `packages/auth` references `const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk')` in a couple integration tests. We should run the auth test matrix against the canary to ensure nothing else is regressed.

mike: Can we also teach CI to run the onboarding sample under a Cloudflare Worker emulator? Would have caught this earlier.

olivia: Filed ISSUE-1291 for adding a worker-emulation job to `ci/samples.yml`.

rachel: PR #4077 opened, includes patch, changelog note about ESM/CJS and node<12 quirks, and a tiny README addition for the onboarding sample explaining import patterns. Marking as patch version 0.8.1.

staging-bot: publish-bot: Published @redwood/sdk@0.8.1-canary.1 for testing.

ben: Running full test matrix now (Node 12/14/16 + worker emulation + auth tests). Will report results in this thread.

mike: Thanks y'all. Once tests green we can backport the doc update to the Dedicated onboarding docs and push the patch.

olivia: Also adding a tiny script to our release checklist to run `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk'))"` for CJS smoke before publishing major changes to exports.

rachel: Good call. I'll add that to RELEASE.md and land PR after CI passes.
